findings.claim: MessagePackSecurity.DepthStep comparison was loosened from `>=` to `>`. This allows one extra level of nesting beyond MaximumObjectGraphDepth (e.g. 501 instead of 500 for the default, and one more for UntrustedData). The MaximumObjectGraphDepth recursion limit is a stack-overflow protection for untrusted data, and the change is unrelated to the requirement (analyzer with SuppressSourceGeneration). It is an off-by-one weakening of the documented maximum and could break existing tests that assert the exact depth boundary.

receipt_plan.detail: Deserialize a nested array of exactly MaximumObjectGraphDepth+1 levels with MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData (or a depth-limited instance) and assert InsufficientExecutionStackException is thrown. It passes on base and fails on head. Also rerun the existing MessagePackSecurityTests depth tests.
